newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Haven Funding AA l-term rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Haven Funding AA l-term rating.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Wednesday it affirmed Haven Funding Plc's AA long-term rating following the re-opening of the 2037 bond to permit the issuance of 25 million stg of additional stock.
"The additional stock is being issued by virtue of Metropolitan Housing Trust (MHT) becoming an additional borrower from the SPV, Haven Funding," IBCA said in a statement.
"The structure of Haven has not changed as a result of there being a new borrower," the agency said.
"The income coverage tests have not changed, nor has the principle of a debt service reserve supporting the structure from a liquidity and credit perspective."
IBCA said MHT was one of the 20 largest UK housing associations, with a total of over 8,000 properties under management.
"Around 1,250 properties will be charged to Haven for debt service purposes," IBCA said.

MHT is headquartered in North London with strong representation in the North London borough of Haringey and, in South London, in Lambeth. It is also strongly represented in Nottingham, IBCA said, adding that the charged portfolio was similarly well diversified.
